evals.prompt: I run a small sourdough micro-bakery in Austin and sell at the Saturday farmers market. Make me an Instagram reel that people will actually share.
evals.expected_output: A full script package: 3 hook options of different types with one recommended, a beat-by-beat table (time, visual, voice-over, on-screen text) of roughly 30-45s, shot list, edit notes, caption with keywords, max 5 hashtags, one share-oriented CTA, platform variants, and a compliance note about music for business accounts and real cost figures.
